name: airgap_verify_pr
description: Verify a GitHub pull request with prompt injection scanning, manifest supply-chain audit, SHA-pinned clone, build, and tests in a single microVM call

arguments.name: test_command
arguments.desc: Command to run in the checked-out PR

arguments.name: build_first
arguments.desc: Force the build script before tests

arguments.name: fail_on_supply_risk
arguments.desc: Block execution when the manifest audit flags high-risk changes

arguments.name: allow_install_scripts
arguments.desc: Allow package-manager lifecycle scripts inside the sandbox

name: airgap_verify_patch
description: Test a local uncommitted patch against clean base files inside an isolated microVM sandbox

arguments.name: files
arguments.desc: Clean base files snapshot as a path-to-content map

name: airgap_sandbox_run
description: Execute arbitrary commands and tests inside a disposable Linux microVM sandbox with secret redaction

arguments.name: command
arguments.desc: Shell command to run in workspace

arguments.name: files
arguments.desc: Optional files to populate before command execution

name: airgap_scan_injection
description: Scan untrusted external issue or pull request text for prompt injection attempts via GMI MaaS

arguments.name: text_content
arguments.desc: The untrusted text to classify for prompt injection

arguments.name: source_label
arguments.desc: Context label indicating where the text originated

name: airgap_redact_secrets
description: Perform high-speed local regex and entropy scrubbing to redact credentials and tokens from text

arguments.name: raw_text
arguments.desc: Raw text, logs, diffs, or env dumps to redact locally

name: airgap_audit_supply
description: Audit dependency manifests for lifecycle install hooks, malicious scripts, and unpinned sources

arguments.name: manifest_type
arguments.desc: Manifest ecosystem type: npm, python, or cargo

arguments.name: manifest_content
arguments.desc: Raw text content of the dependency manifest file

name: airgap_audit_repo
description: Perform a multi-phase defensive security review of a repository snapshot

arguments.name: files
arguments.desc: Repository snapshot as a path-to-content map

name: airgap_configure
description: Configure execution runtime defaults such as model and timeout
